Brand: Gold Medal

Product: All‑Purpose Bleached Flour

Size: Available in 5 lb, 10 lb (160 oz), 2 lb, 48 oz, 32 oz bags

Type: Enriched, bleached, and presifted flour—ready to use straight from the bag
features:
Features

All-purpose versatility: Ideal for a wide range of recipes including cookies, cakes, muffins, pancakes, and bread.

Bleached flour: Finely milled and whitened for a lighter texture and brighter appearance in baked goods.

Enriched with nutrients: Fortified with iron and B vitamins including niacin, thiamine, riboflavin, and folic acid.

Trusted brand: Produced by Gold Medal, a leading name in flour with over 130 years of baking heritage.

Consistent quality: Delivers predictable results every time due to uniform grind and formulation.

Resealable packaging: Keeps flour fresh and easy to store. 

Benefits

Reliable performance: Ensures consistent texture and rise in baked goods, making it a favorite among home and professional bakers.

Nutrient-rich option: Enrichment with essential vitamins and minerals supports dietary needs.

Time-saving: No need to sift—Gold Medal flour is pre-sifted for convenience.

Cost-effective: Provides great value for bulk baking or regular use.

Beginner-friendly: Easy to work with for bakers at all skill levels, from everyday cooking to holiday baking projects.
ingredients: BLEACHED WHEAT FLOUR, NIACIN (A B VITAMIN), IRON, THIAMINE MONONITRATE (VITAMIN B1), RIBOFLAVIN (VITAMIN B2), ENZYMES, FOLIC ACID (A B VITAMIN).
